business_type: secular grower (custom AI silicon + infrastructure software)
moat_source: multi-year custom-ASIC design lock-in with hyperscalers plus VMware software switching costs; evidence: AI revenue guided +180% with record FCF, and customers co-invest years ahead (Apple through 2031)

returns.assumption_note: Convergence to scenario IV by year 5, ~60% of the gap closed by year 3. Returns exclude the dividend (~1-2%/yr), so stated figures are modestly conservative.

primary_model_risk: Custom-ASIC program risk: the 2027 $100B+ AI target rests on a handful of hyperscaler XPU programs whose cancellation or descoping is opaque until it happens. Base case credits ~$100B in 2027; the bear case (programs cut in an AI-capex digestion) is the difference between $340 and $167 of intrinsic value.
expectations_gap_key_variable: 2027 AI revenue: the market prices roughly full delivery of the $100B+ guide (price ~12% above our expected IV); we weight a modest shortfall - the disagreement is small, hence hold rather than avoid
top_5_bull_arguments: AI semiconductor revenue compounding at +180-200% y/y with $56B guided for FY2026 and $100B+ reiterated for 2027
Record FCF quarter after quarter funds dividends, buybacks, and VMware deleveraging simultaneously
Apple extension to 2031 converts the largest customer risk into visible multi-year revenue
Custom silicon is the structural hedge against NVIDIA concentration for every hyperscaler - AVGO is the default partner
VMware software adds a sticky, high-margin second engine unrelated to the AI cycle
top_5_bear_arguments: 62x trailing earnings prices flawless execution of a target (2027 AI $100B+) that management itself calls a guide, not a booking
Q2 already missed consensus and the Q3 AI guide disappointed - the first hairline cracks (Erste downgrade July 7)
Expected IV ($334.80) sits ~10% below the price; risk/reward is mildly negative before the dividend
Debt from VMware constrains optionality if the AI capex cycle digests in 2027-2028
Custom-ASIC economics invite NVIDIA pricing retaliation exactly when hyperscaler budgets tighten
thesis_breakers: Any hyperscaler XPU program cancellation or material descoping
2027 AI revenue guidance walked back below $80B
FCF margin compression below 40% of revenue
Apple partnership renegotiated or descoped despite the 2031 extension
position_size_recommendation: 0-2%; fair-value territory - add on capex-scare drawdowns toward expected IV (~$335) rather than at the current quote
notes_on_nulls: ROIC/ROE/ROA null: not captured as sourced ratios. Revenue and guidance figures are reported (press releases); FCF is described as 'record' in the release but not itemized in captured coverage, so the FCF path is calibrated to Broadcom's historically ~50% FCF margin - confidence_level medium.
historical_context: Directional context only - low confidence. Verified datapoints: +5.3% single-day move on the Apple extension (July 2026), +0.54% past week, 62.11x trailing P/E (pass1). No verified 5-year multiple range captured.
